Verification already done by me: pnpm typecheck, lint, format:check, check:ledger, check:comments, pnpm test (1569 pass), pnpm test:privacy (279 pass), web build, all green; the pre-commit hook will run `pnpm check` and `pnpm test` again (takes a few minutes: use a long Bash timeout, 600000 ms, and if the hook fails report the output, do not bypass it).

Rules: never use --no-verify, never change git config (no `git config`, no core.hooksPath), never force-push, never commit on another branch, do not merge, do not pass --auto to gh. Do not edit files.

Step 1: `git add` exactly the changed and untracked files shown by `git status --short` (all of them belong to the change; there should be 28: web UI + tests, api, domain, cloudflare incl. new d1 migration 0012 and lock, ADR docs/adr/0028-offboarding-returns-no-results.md, docs/compliance/ropa.md). Verify nothing else (no .env, no scratch files) is present first.

Step 2: commit with subject exactly `GDPR 308: offboard an Organization` and this body, then the trailer line:

Offboarding an Organization returns data without giving an Organization admin every Team's Results, so ADR 0003 stands. The export holds only the Organization settings, Teams, People, Memberships, Pulses and Questions; it excludes Results, comments, Actions, Notes, Submissions, Answers and every token. ADR 0028 records this.

Deleting an Organization needs the typed Organization name and the new organization.offboard permission (Organization admin only). It wipes the Organization's Durable Object (deleteAlarm then deleteAll) and its D1 index: token indexes first so Invitation tokens and Edit keys fail closed, then email_message and captured_email by message id, person_index, organization_claim and organization_index, then the sign-in accounts left without a Person. organization_offboarding lets the same admin finish after a crash.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Step 3: push. First try `git push -u origin gdpr-308-offboarding`. If it is rejected or errors (the origin remote is an entire:// URL that has failed here for fetches), retry with `git push -v origin HEAD:gdpr-308-offboarding`; if that also fails, run `git -c 'credential.helper=!gh auth git-credential' push https://github.com/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next.git gdpr-308-offboarding:gdpr-308-offboarding`. Never force-push. Confirm with `gh api repos/chrisdoc/surveybeat-next/branches/gdpr-308-offboarding --jq .commit.sha` that the remote branch head equals `git rev-parse HEAD`.

Step 4: open the PR: `gh pr create --base main --head gdpr-308-offboarding --title "GDPR 308: offboard an Organization"` with a body that starts with the line `Closes #308`, then a short summary (the export excludes Results so ADR 0003 stands; deletion wipes the Durable Object and the D1 index; crash order via organization_offboarding; backups expire after Policy.backupRetentionDays (30) days; tests: privacy suite OrganizationOffboarding.privacy.test.ts, DirectoryApi tests, domain and web tests), and end with the line `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)`. Do not merge, do not pass --auto, do not post review comments.

Report back: the PR URL, the full 40-char head SHA (git rev-parse HEAD), the commit hook outcome, and which push command worked.
